description:
Hit the trails on a hardtail!

The ultimate hardtail mountain bike for thrill-seekers and adventurers alike! With its high-quality features, this bike is guaranteed to elevate your riding experience to new heights. The Vibe's lightweight formed aluminum frame boasts a tapered head tube and internally routed cables, ensuring a sleek and smooth ride. The SR Suntour XCM30 front suspension fork has 100mm of travel, and provides unparalleled control and stability on even the roughest terrain. The front and rear mechanical disc brakes offer reliable stopping power no matter the conditions. Thanks to the height-adjustable seat post with quick release, you can easily customize your ride to fit your body perfectly. The 8 speed Microshift drivetrain provides plenty of gearing range and is equipped with smooth trigger shifters. The lightweight aluminum wheels are nimble and rust resistant, and the knobby MTB tires provide superior traction and control. Whether you're an experienced mountain biker or just starting out, the Ozark Trail® Vibe is the perfect bike for your next outdoor adventure.

KEY FEATURES:

Adjustable Seat Post with Quick Release
27.5" Knobby MTB Tires with Presta Valve
